description: This source file defines FastAPI route handlers for transaction operations within a banking backend. It includes endpoints for depositing, withdrawing, and transferring funds between accounts, with database interactions handled asynchronously via asyncpg.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a transaction record, including fields such as id, account_id, type, amount, description, related_account_id, and created_at.

methods.name: _get_account_for_user(conn: asyncpg.Connection, account_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches an account record for a specific user given account and user IDs.

methods.name: Transaction deposit(payload: DepositRequest, conn: asyncpg.Connection = Depends(get_connection), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles the deposit of funds into an account, updating the balance and creating a new transaction record.

methods.name: Transaction withdraw(payload: WithdrawRequest, conn: asyncpg.Connection = Depends(get_connection), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles the withdrawal of funds from an account, updating the balance and creating a new transaction record, with check for sufficient funds.

methods.name: Transaction transfer(payload: TransferRequest, conn: asyncpg.Connection = Depends(get_connection), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles transfer of funds between two accounts owned by the user, updating both balances atomically and creating paired transaction records.

ctags.name: _get_account_for_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def _get_account_for_user(conn: asyncpg.Connection, account_id: int, user_id: int):$/

ctags.name: deposit
ctags.pattern: /^async def deposit(payload: DepositRequest, conn: asyncpg.Connection = Depends(get_connection), u/

ctags.name: transfer
ctags.pattern: /^async def transfer(payload: TransferRequest, conn: asyncpg.Connection = Depends(get_connection),/

ctags.name: withdraw
ctags.pattern: /^async def withdraw(payload: WithdrawRequest, conn: asyncpg.Connection = Depends(get_connection),/
